title: WordPress 7.0 Armstrong Launches with Native AI Integration
summary: WordPress 7.0 introduces AI Client SDK, Abilities API, and three official provider plugins. Native WordPress AI Assistant integrated directly into site editor for Business/Commerce plans. MCP support enables AI agents to read/write site content, analytics, and settings.

title: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Now as Critical as Traditional SEO
summary: SEO is becoming AEO. Getting surfaced in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews is now equally important as ranking in search results. Passage structure and cross-source consistency matter more than backlinks.

title: Rankings and AI Citations Have Officially Decoupled
summary: Top-10 Google rankers accounted for 76% of AI Overview citations mid-2025, but dropped to 38% by early 2026. Traditional rankings and AI citation visibility no longer correlate directly.

title: 75% of Marketers Now Use Generative AI
summary: Client expectations are shifting rapidly. AI adoption across content generation, personalisation, SEO support, creative assets, video editing, workflow automation, and performance analytics is now mainstream.

title: Anthropic Confidentially Files for IPO at $965B Valuation
summary: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with SEC for potential IPO after Series H funding round ($65B). Company reports $47B annualised revenue. Now valued higher than OpenAI ($852B as of March 2026).

title: AI Search Platform Traffic Growing 527% YoY
summary: Traffic from LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) grew 527% year-over-year, forming a new discovery channel alongside declining traditional organic clicks.

title: Agentic AI Now Autonomously Managing Marketing Campaigns
summary: Emerging capability: agentic AI systems can design campaign strategies, generate ad variations, deploy across platforms, monitor performance, and adjust messaging in real-time with minimal human intervention.

title: Generative AI Marketing Market Growing to £4.35B (32.4% CAGR)
summary: Market expanded from £3.29B (2025) to £4.35B (2026). Growth driven by adoption of AI-powered content, personalisation, social management, ad optimisation, and predictive analytics.
